description: Guild channel talk from Living Server, rewritten.

lines.text: {level} {class} here, anyone close in level?
Who is leveling tonight? Could use the company.
Anyone know a good camp around {level}?
Anyone else stuck in the slow levels?
Anyone free to heal for a couple hours of experience?
Half a level to go, anyone want to help me push?
What level is everyone at now?
Leveling with you lot makes the slow nights go faster.
I swear this level is twice as long as the last one.
Solo experience is crawling tonight.
Got a full bubble on one pull, best camp yet.
New camp, everything cons yellow, experience is great.
Dinged {level}, slowly getting there.
This guild is the best part of my week, just saying.
Just watched someone run a train through a whole camp, poor group.
Who has the worst luck with drops? Pretty sure it is me.
Our healers carried us again last night, just saying.
Who is up for the frontier tonight?
Anyone heard which keeps we hold right now?
Realm points were good last night, again tonight?
Need more healers for the frontier, any volunteers?
Who has their first realm ability yet?
Eight-man practice tonight? We keep losing to the same group.
We need a guild claim on a keep, thoughts?
Got ganked at the mile gate again, stealthers everywhere.
The {enemyrealm} were everywhere last night.
Stealthers had a good night, my corpse can confirm.
{enemyrealm} relic raid rumors again, keep an eye out.
Just got a realm rank, so happy.
We need two more healers for the dragon, any takers?
Who has decent fire resists for the dragon?
Need a main assist for the next raid, volunteers?
Loot rules for the raid, need before greed all right?
Dragon raid soon, start saving potions.
Last raid was a mess, let us plan better this time.
Bring every rez class we have, we will need them.
Raid recap: two wipes, one kill, I call that a win.
We wiped on the named but we were so close.
Who has a full crafted suit for raids?
Skilling up tonight if anyone wants to keep me company.
Hit a new skill tier, finally.
Found a dye color I actually like, finally.
Making {level} gear to skill up, the merchants get most of it.
Alchemy is finally paying off.
Sold a full suit today, guild discount of course.
I need metal bars, lots of them.
Anyone else grinding tailoring? Misery loves company.
Anyone near a forge? I could use the company while I grind.
Anyone know what spellcraft gems sell for these days?
Masterpiece! First one in weeks.
Spellcraft is eating all my gold.
99 percent quality again, so close.
The merchants raised leather prices again.
Crafting is a money pit but I love it.
Anyone want a slightly ugly helm? The dye went wrong.
Two skill points in an hour, legendary by retirement at this rate.
Anyone have spare cloth lying around?
Making arrows all night, my fingers hurt.
Anyone on?
Hey guild.
Slow night, anyone doing anything?
Anyone know a good spot for a {class} at {level}?
Nothing beats a quiet night with the guild.
My {class} is finally starting to feel strong.
Saving up for new armor, slowly.
Thanks all for the help earlier.
New spec feels good, glad I changed it.
Found a named nobody was camping, best surprise all week.
{class} at {level}, bored, ideas?
How is everyone's night going?
Need a break from experience, anyone want to just chat?
Who wants to help a guildmate with a named?
How does everyone have so much money?
Got a nice drop, of course it is for another class.
Camping {zone} solo, it is peaceful.
Running around {zone} looking for trouble.
Anyone near {zone}? Could use a hand.
Need a rez in {zone} if anyone is near, no rush.
Bags full again, off to sell.
Just dinged, thanks for all the tips everyone.
Lost a chunk of experience on that death, ugh.
Just died to a grey con, do not ask.
Heading to town to sell, then back out.
Hey guild, how is everyone doing?
So how is the guild doing tonight?
Hello guild, long time no see.
Guild chat is lively tonight, love it.
Hi guild, quiet one tonight huh.
Our tank still owes me a rez from last time.
Nobody let me pull again, trust me.
Our healers deserve medals.
I swear some of you would die to a grey con if I looked away.
The guild record for deaths in one night is safe for now.
Our tank's idea of a plan is run in and see.
The guild that wipes together stays together.
I would complain about the guild but you lot are the only ones who laugh at my jokes.
If anyone needs me I will be hiding behind our tank, as usual.
Pretty sure half this guild is held together by potions and luck.
This guild has the worst luck with rolls, it is uncanny.
Somebody in this guild keeps stealing my kills and I know you do it on purpose.
We are not a guild, we are a support group for bad pulls.
I love how nobody reads the loot rules until they lose a roll.
Our guild chat is ninety percent jokes and ten percent pull timers.
Purple con, no problem, said the guild member we will miss.
Called it a calculated risk, the guild called it a wipe.
Some of us are leveling while the rest chat all night, just saying.
The late crew is the real guild, the day people just visit.
At this rate I will hit the next level some time next year.
Our healers level so fast because nobody lets them solo.
The fastest leveler in the guild is a mystery.
My experience bar and I are no longer on speaking terms.
Guild rule: if you ding, you owe the channel a story.
Someone here leveled three times this week and still asks for tips.
Outleveled half the guild this week, feels good.
The slow levels are eating my soul.
Spent the whole day staring at spreadsheets, give me mobs instead.
Summer cannot come soon enough, so much leveling planned.
If anyone had a rough day, hang in there.
Have not seen some of you in a while, hope all is well.
Who had the best day today? Share it.
Hey all, how is everybody feeling tonight?
Everyone surviving the week?
So, real question, how is everyone actually doing?
We should get everyone together sometime.
Would be fun to fill a whole group with guildmates sometime.
Someday this guild will take a keep, mark my words.
When more of us are higher, we should try something bigger.
I like that we never make plans and somehow it still works.
The best guild nights are the ones nobody planned.
We should write down the best guild stories somewhere.
Our tabard could use a new color, just saying.
We need a guild motto, ideas welcome.
Any interest in a guild duel night some time? Just for fun.
We should have a guild night where nobody is allowed to talk about experience.
We should all go sightseeing as a guild some night, no experience, just views.
When the slow levels are behind us, let us plan something big.
Anyone able to fix up my armor sometime?
Need a new bow at some point, no rush.
Saving up for a crafted suit, the drops are not cutting it.
Dyed my armor a new color, not sure about it.
Spellcrafting makes my head hurt.
My gear is held together by hope and repair bills.
Would love a matching set someday, mine looks like a patchwork quilt.
Our crafters are the unsung heroes of this guild.
Whoever made my last weapon, it is still going strong, thanks.
My armor is so mismatched people think I am wearing a costume.
If anyone has spare leather lying around, I could use some.
Skilling up tailoring, send me your leftovers if you have any.
Happy to make things for guildmates at cost, just ask.
Every time I craft something I just end up selling it to a vendor.
Just hit a new tier in my craft, so happy.
Made a helm that came out perfect, feeling proud.
Another 99 percent piece, the craft gods mock me.
My crafting bar barely moved tonight, this is a long road.
Finally got a drop worth keeping, small wins.
Made some decent coin today, new boots fund is growing.
Won a roll against three people for a nice drop earlier, never happens to me.
Survived a nasty add with a sliver of health, heart is racing.
My new spec is paying off, so glad I switched.
Finally beat that one mob that keeps killing me.
Got a lucky crit on a yellow, felt like a hero for five seconds.
My first big sale, the merchant did not even blink.
Got a compliment on my armor from a stranger, best moment of the night.
Killed something orange solo and nobody saw it, so you will have to trust me.
Found a quiet spot nobody seems to know about, keeping it secret.
Lost a bubble to a silly pull earlier, lesson learned.
Sold something for nothing and found out later it was worth a lot.
Rolled for it and lost again, the dice hate me.
Spent an hour camping a named and it never showed.
Forgot to repair and paid for it.
Died with a full bag of loot earlier, the run back was quiet and sad.
My lucky streak ended the moment I said it out loud.
Missed a level by a sliver before the group broke up, so close.
Nothing dropped all evening except my hopes.
Fell off a ledge I have walked past a hundred times, no idea how.
Never forget the great pull.
As the guild motto goes, it was blue when I pulled it.
Remember when we trained a whole camp.
The guild mascot should be a grey con.
Ten gold says our tank dies first tonight.
Still laughing about the jump from last night, no regrets.
Still not over that one roll.
If anyone asks, the guild was never lost, we were exploring.
The official guild response to a train is still to scream and run.
We should hang a plaque for the most dramatic death of the month.
Every guild needs one person who jumps off ledges for fun, and we have three.
Somewhere out there is a mob that still remembers us, and it is not happy.
Our guild has a long and proud tradition of running the wrong way.
I keep a list of the funniest things said in this channel, it is getting long.
The late crew has seen things the day crew would not believe.
I love a quiet night with the guild.
Best thing about this guild is nobody yells.
Just here to chat for a bit, ignore me.
Some nights I do not even care about experience.
It is nice having a place where someone always says hi back.
Nobody else gets my jokes like this guild does.
One day I will be the one handing out tips instead of asking for them.
What do you all think, is it more fun to level fast or slow?
Favorite part of a guild night for you all?
Spent an hour just running around looking at things, no regrets.
I craft, you fight, the guild runs on teamwork.
Experience is slow but the chat is good, so it evens out.
Good to be back in guild chat after a busy week.
Checking on the guild, everyone in one piece?
I keep saying one more, I have said it six times.
Never say 'this is easy' in guild chat, we all know what happens.
I trust this guild with my life but not with the loot rolls.
If you ever need a lesson in running away, ask our tank.
I see someone changed their guild title again, very fancy.
Nobody in this guild has ever looked at the map and it shows.
There are two kinds of guildmates, those who read the quest and those who ask in here.
The healers keep a list of who stands in the bad stuff, and some of you are on it twice.
We have a guild superstition: never say the words easy pull.
Our guild has a strict policy: if it moves, someone will pull it.
The guild handbook is one page and it says do not pull the room.
Best drop of my week earlier, cannot stop smiling.
Got my first matching piece of armor, now I look half put together.
Ran out of potions and still made it, barely.
Found some coin in my bank I forgot about, happy surprise.
Ran out of potions at the worst time, never again.
Sold my best ring by accident, I want to cry.
My bind point was miles away, the run back took forever.
Group broke up right as I was about to ding, so close.
Spent my coin on a weapon and the next mob dropped a better one.
Anyone making arrows these days?
Anyone else think the dye merchants should sell more colors?
My cloak and armor do not match and I have stopped caring.
Repair bills are eating me alive, a guild crafter would save my purse.
Tailoring is slow but I love it.
Crafting tip from a tired crafter: buy your materials in bulk.
Need someone to talk to while I craft for an hour.
Got my first masterpiece in a while, it lives in my bags now.
A costume night where everyone wears the same color would be fun.
If anyone has ideas for guild nights, toss them in here.
The guild could use a few more healers someday, just thinking out loud.
A guild race some time would be fun, last one there buys potions.
I will ding eventually, one bubble at a time.
Anyone else feel like this level is cursed?
Half the fun of leveling is complaining about it in here.
Guild experience report: slow but steady.
Slow and steady, the guild way.
Leveling is better with guild chat open, the bubbles go faster.
The frontier is more fun with guildmates, even when we lose.
My realm rank is tiny but my heart is huge.
Someday I will understand siege, today is not that day.
My corpse has seen more of the frontier than I have.
Anyone want to duo for a bit? {level} {class}.
Who needs experience tonight? Let us get a guild group going.
Any healers around {level} want to group up?
Ding! {level}, finally.
In a pickup group, nice people so far.
Soloing in {zone}, shout if you want company.
Who wants to do a guild run through all the capitals?
Who has purge? Asking for our next fight.
Assist train worked well last night, let us keep it.
Anyone want to practice duels? Need to learn my class.
How many are on for the frontier? Need a headcount.
Remember to bring siege gear, we always forget.
{enemyrealm} on {keep}, everyone who can, get out there.
Out in the frontier, group up if you are near.
Raid at eight, bring potions and resists.
Who has the most rez classes on tonight?
Need a raid leader for the next one, anyone?
Who is pulling for the raid, same as last time?
Everyone set your bind before the raid please.
Raid tips: stay off the walls and watch the leader.
Who is our best weaponcrafter these days?
Anyone have a tailor who can do a full suit?
Need someone to spellcraft my armor, will pay.
What does everyone charge for a {level} suit?
Anyone selling dyes cheap?
Best way to skill up fletching, anyone?
Crafting order: two bows and a quiver, who can?
If you need potions, I know an alchemist.
Who can make me a shield with our emblem on it?
Anyone tried dyeing leather black? Does it look all right?
What is the best metal to buy for skilling right now?
Anyone have a spare horse ticket?
Anyone need help with a quest? I have time.
Need a hand with my epic quest, anyone?
Bags are bursting, anyone want some vendor trash?
Died to something I should have seen coming, lesson learned.
In a dungeon, might be slow to answer.
